purpose: Keep repeated governance shorthand out of reader-facing prose and require context-specific plain language instead.
publicSurfaceCoverage: MDX case studies and lab copy
homepage, site, social-card, project, and work-cover data
renderable public citation labels and notes
all Markdown and JSON in the public resume-version tree
nonPublicExclusions: research-only observations, limitations, and support labels that cannot render publicly
replacementPrinciple: Name the actual relationship: well-scoped requirement, focused pathway, dated snapshot, defined classification, specific evidence, turning point, limited credit, or supportable claim.

acceptance.condition: The assembled reader-facing corpus contains zero case-insensitive whole-word occurrences.
